info.title: Device Registry API
info.description:
REST API of a device registry: device types, contracts and the device units on them.

- A **device** is a device *type* (manufacturer + model), not a physical unit.
- A physical unit is a device **assigned to a contract** with its own **serial number**.
  The same device type can be on several contracts, or several times on one contract,
  but every serial number is unique across all contracts.
- Devices and contracts that are in use cannot be deleted (409 Conflict).
- Every error is JSON: `{"message": "..."}`, plus `errors` per field on 422.
- Requests are limited to 60 per minute per client IP.

The serial number identifies the physical unit and is unique across all contracts.
The same device type can be added several times with different serial numbers.

delete.description:
The assignment is resolved through the contract (scoped binding),
so an assignment of another contract answers 404.
